title: Core: lighting config, deterministic exposure model, per-biome exposure bias
player_outcome: No visible change yet. This adds the tuning data and the pure logic that P1-03/P1-04 use to stop desert and snow blowing out while caves still adapt.
design: Add src/Strata.Core/Presentation/LightingConfig.cs (Path = data/config/lighting.json), following the GraphicsConfig/GrassConfig pattern: Load(IDataSource) via ContentJson.Options, List<string> Validate().
Exposure section fields: CaveBoost 1.7, NightBoost 1.2, BrightenPerSecond 0.5, DarkenPerSecond 2.5, AutoKey 0.35, AutoMin 0.72, AutoMax 1.45, AutoSpeed 1.0.
Glow section: Threshold 1.6, Softness 2.5, Intensity 0.6, LuminanceCap 8, Levels[7] = [0,0,1,1,0.8,0.5,0.25].
Fog section: NearCap 70 m. ScreenSpace section: SsilIntensity 0.9, VolumetricAlbedo 0.8.

Torch section: PlacedEnergy 1.5, PlacedRangeBase 4, PlacedRangePerPeak 9.5, PlacedAttenuation 0.6, HeldEnergy 2.0, HeldRangeBase 4, HeldRangePerPeak 12, HeldAttenuation 0.6. BlockLight section: Linear 0.62, Gain 1.35, DaylitSuppression 0.65.
Validate ranges: 0 < AutoMin <= 1 <= AutoMax <= 4; CaveBoost 1-3; per-second rates > 0; Levels has 7 non-negative values with sum > 0; energies > 0; attenuation 0.2-2.

Add src/Strata.Core/Presentation/ExposureModel.cs, a pure class. static float Target(ExposureSettings s, float outdoor, float daylight, float biomeBias) = Lerp(s.CaveBoost, Lerp(s.NightBoost, 1, daylight) * Lerp(1, biomeBias, daylight), outdoor).

ExposureModel also gets float Current (starts at 1) and void Step(float target, float dt): asymmetric exponential, rising at BrightenPerSecond and falling at DarkenPerSecond, so leaving a cave darkens fast and never flashbangs.

ExposureModel also gets static (float MinSensitivity, float MaxSensitivity) AutoWindow(ExposureSettings) = (AutoKey/AutoMax/0.00125, AutoKey/AutoMin/0.00125). Document the Godot conversion: luminance = ISO * 12.5/100/100 at exposure_sensitivity 100. This is why today's 85/170 window pins the multiplier to 1.65-3.3x.
BiomeDef: add public float ExposureBias { get; init; } = 1f with the doc 'open-air daytime exposure multiplier; bright sand and snow < 1'.
ContentValidator.World.ValidateBiomes: report an error when ExposureBias is outside 0.4-1.5.
ValidateCommand: load and validate lighting.json next to graphics.json (Error: lines on problems).
Write data/config/lighting.json with a comment on every value. Files under config/ are excluded from the content manifest, so no manifest change is needed.

data/config/lighting.json: new file with the values listed in design

risks: These numbers are starting points. P1-03/P1-04 calibrate them from screenshots, so keep every value in data, not code.
The ISO-to-luminance factor is Godot's internal convention. Add a comment linking CameraAttributesPractical._update_auto_exposure.
